title: Excavation unearths new artefacts of Châu Sa Citadel of ancient Chăm people
description: The excavation results have provided valuable facts to 'decipher' a transitional historical period that has very little documentation about the citadel, known as the only remaining relatively intact earthen citadel of the ancient Chăm People.

title: Debate Over Ancient Iranian Jewelry Worn by Zendaya to ‘Odyssey’ Event
description: The actress wore earrings to an event for “The Odyssey” that a London gallery has said were made from an ancient artifact.

title: Ancient Lebanese city of Tyre on heritage danger list
description: PARIS - Tyre, an ancient Phoenician city in southern Lebanon hit in recent months by Israeli bombardment, was on Wednesday added to the Unesco list of world heritage sites in danger.
